purpose: Original companion coastal studio illustrations, matching the approved homepage character and daylight palette.

files.prompt: Create a new wide editorial illustration for the IAVSE creative community website. The attached image is a style, setting and character reference only: retain its delicate hand-painted anime watercolor / gouache linework, bright low-contrast ivory paper, pale powder-blue sea, sage leaves, warm apricot sunlight, and the same adult woman with very long flowing blue-black hair, ivory and pale apricot blouse. Make a DIFFERENT scene and composition: an intimate overhead three-quarter view of her sunlit coastal studio worktable, the woman seated at the LEFT third sorting physical loose sketches and a small open notebook, pencil in one hand, two or three carefully arranged pages and art books, ceramic cup, white jasmine, sunlight and soft leaf shadows across the paper; a glimpse of the luminous sea through an open window behind. A thoughtful, lived-in creative workspace, calm and generous, beautifully detailed but clean. The table and her creative hands are the focal point, character face naturally drawn. Landscape 3:2 composition, full bleed, real spatial depth. Original illustration, no visible text, no words, no logos, no fake software screens, no floating cards, no UI mockups, no watermark. Preserve light and subtle color; avoid excessive bloom or vague white haze.
files.processing: Proportional resize and WebP compression only.
